description: Chromatograms from mass spectra and detector signals: TIC, BPC, extracted-ion (mz with ppm or da), SRM/MRM transitions, stored chromatograms and UV/DAD/FID/TCD traces (traces). Per chromatogram: apex time and intensity, integral, and thinned arrays. Answers 'when does m/z X elute'.

aggregate.description: `sum` (default) or `max` of the points inside an XIC window.

channel.description: Channel of the traces (e.g. one DAD wavelength). Default: the first signal channel.

da.description: XIC tolerance in m/z units instead of ppm.

file.description: Path to the file or data-set directory.

max_points.description: Points returned per chromatogram (the most intense point of each of N equal slices). Default 500, max 20000; the summary (apex, integral) always covers every point.

ms_level.description: MS level of the scans. Default 1 (2 with `precursor`).

mz.description: Extracted-ion chromatograms at these m/z values (one streaming pass for all).

mz_range.description: TIC/BPC over this m/z range only, `[low, high]`.

polarity.description: `positive` or `negative`: only scans of this polarity.

precursor.description: Only MS/MS scans of this precursor m/z (product-ion XIC).

profile.description: Use profile data where scans store both profile and centroids. Default false (the instrument's centroids).

scan_filter.description: Only scans whose scan filter/description contains this text (case-insensitive).

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

sweep.description: Sweep of the traces (one spectrum of a map or series, one injection). Default 0.

tic.description: Total-ion chromatogram (the default for mass-spectrometry files when nothing else is chosen).

traces.description: Stored chromatograms or detector signals (UV/DAD, FID, TCD, stored TIC/SRM): trace indices from openreadout_info → traces[].

transition_tol.description: Q1/Q3 tolerance of transitions, m/z units. Default 0.5.

name: openreadout_chromatogram

Chromatogram.description:
One chromatogram: retention times (minutes) and intensities, with how they were obtained
and a summary.

apex_intensity.description: Intensity of the most intense point.

apex_rt_min.description: Retention time of the most intense point, minutes.

decimated.description:
True when `rt_min`/`intensity` were thinned to `max_points` (the most intense point of
each of `max_points` equal slices is kept); the summary covers every point.

integral.description: Trapezoidal integral of the whole chromatogram (no baseline), intensity × minutes.

intensity_source.description:
TIC/BPC: points from the scan's recorded value (`recorded`), from its points
(`computed`), or both (`mixed`).

intensity_unit.description: Unit of `intensity` (`counts` for mass spectra, the detector's unit for traces).

ms_level.description: MS level of the scans used.

precursor_mz.description: SRM: the precursor (Q1) m/z matched in the file.

product_mz.description: SRM: the product (Q3) m/z matched in the file.

profile_scans.description: Scans read as profiles (their points inside the window are summed).

source.description:
Where the points come from: `spectra` (computed from the mass spectra), `trace N`
(a stored chromatogram or detector signal) or `table N` (an MRM table column).

format.description: Format id of the input file.

run.description: Spectra run used, when any chromatogram was computed from spectra.
